target.title: fix: long mobile media recordings time out
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users asking a paired mobile node to record a longer `camera_clip` or `screen_record` could hit a gateway timeout before the recording had enough time to finish.

The dedicated media tool already accepted long recording durations, and the mobile apps clamp legal recordings to as much as 60 seconds. However, the agent-to-gateway request path and the forwarded `node.invoke` request still used the default 30 second budget unless the caller manually supplied a timeout.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change derives a recording-specific timeout for `camera_clip` and `screen_record` from the requested duration plus a 30 second grace window. The same timeout is applied to both layers that need to wait: the agent client's gateway call and the gateway's forwarded `node.invoke` payload.

Explicit caller-provided `timeoutMs` remains authoritative. If a caller intentionally supplies a shorter or longer deadline, the media tool preserves that value instead of silently overriding it.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the affected media tool, the gateway `node.invoke` timeout path, Android/iOS recording duration clamps, and added focused regression coverage.

## User Impact

Users can request longer mobile camera clips or screen recordings through the dedicated node media actions without the gateway timing out at 30 seconds by default. Short recordings and explicit timeout overrides keep their existing behavior.

## Evidence

Local validation focused on the touched agent media-tool surface:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/nodes-tool.test.ts`
  - Result: 1 test file passed, 42 tests passed.
  - Coverage added for default long-recording timeout derivation on both `screen_record` and `camera_clip`.
  - Coverage added to verify an explicit `timeoutMs` remains authoritative.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/tools/nodes-tool-media.ts src/agents/tools/nodes-tool.test.ts`
  - Result: all matched files use the correct format.
- `git diff --check`
  - Result: no whitespace errors.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main`
  - Result: clean, no accepted/actionable findings reported after addressing the initial client-timeout and explicit-timeout review notes.

CI will run on this draft PR before it is marked ready.
